framework_lessons: Separate company solvency from investor access.
assessment: The US-equity and Bitcoin cautions were useful, but Fed-under-tightening and dollar-bearishness were clear misses. This report also changes the inflation call from an explicitly local peak to a headline peak, making June a timing failure. Brazil's supportive annual outcomes do not validate every proposed currency mechanism, and Russian investor risk proved broader than the US-only framing.

Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
